violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wet wiping cloth was found stored at the base of shake machine. Wet wiping cloths should be stored in a sanitizing solution between uses or laundered.

Time as a public health control. — --Food was not marked or identified with the time within which it must be cooked, served, or discarded. Tomatoes, lettuce, cheese found in ice bath on hot hold unit without time markings, when time use was indicated by staff. Staff also indicated they would be putting the items back out for supper. Items would be out for 6 hours. Time must be marked and items discarded after 4 hours when time is used as a control.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Blade on commercial can opener was found dirty. Blade should be cleaned and maintained clean.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Shelving in the walk-in cooler and the reach-in cooler were found dirty. Shelves should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towels or another approved means for drying hands was not available at hand washing sink near shake machines. Paper towels or another approved means for drying hands must be available at all times.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. Flooring in front of the sliding glass refrigerator in the kitchen was found with broken, cracked or missing tiles. Floor should be maintained in good repair.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wet wiping cloth found stored on the side of the wiping cloth bucket, solution at 0ppm. Wiping cloths should be stored in the sanitizing solution between uses.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single use items found stored on the floor during inspection. Single use items should be stored off of the floor.

Food display and service. — --Potentially hazardous food was not kept at an internal temperature of 41F or below during display or service. Sauce and beef used for making pizzas were found at 56F and 52F during inspection. Potentially hazardous foods should be maintained at 41F or below.
